description:
The focused test command the engineering contract gives for `gf2-core` does not compile with default features, and several kernel tests call AVX2 code without detecting the feature.

## Background

`cargo nextest run -p gf2-core --cargo-profile ci-test --profile ci`, the focused example in the repository's engineering contract, fails to compile: `crates/gf2-core/tests/tuning_conservative_cfg.rs` calls `support::prepared_core_json`, which exists only under the `tuning-profile` feature, and the build without `simd` warns of an unused `super::*` import. The CI contract builds with `--all-features` and never sees it. Separately, tests in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/avx2.rs` obtain the AVX2 function bundle and call it without checking that the host supports AVX2.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `gf2-core` test targets compile and pass with default features, with `simd` alone and with all features on Rust 1.95, and the CI contract runs at least one configuration without `--all-features` for `gf2-core`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every test in the kernel crate that executes an AVX2 kernel is skipped or takes the tested fallback on a host without AVX2, shown by the test's own feature check.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test asserts a route that the build's feature set cannot select.

## Notes

Found while running the kernel crate's suites with and without the `simd` feature.
title: Make gf2-core tests build without all features and gate AVX2 kernel tests
